column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Passive Scan Rules for Kura LMS
# Every non-default rule below is an accepted passive-scan false positive or informational tag.
# Any unlisted WARN or FAIL finding breaks CI because fail_action is enabled in security.yml.
# Rule 10015 (Re-examine Cache-control Directives): fires on /privacy/, a static public notice
# with zero user-specific or sensitive content. Authenticated views emit private/no-store headers.

column3: Public static privacy page has no sensitive or session-bound content

column1: # Rule 10027 (Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments): matches ordinary code comments in

# because Kura intentionally prevents shared proxies from caching login pages and redirects.

column3: Intentional anti-caching headers on login and redirect responses
